messages:
riley_sales: OceanBank procurement says their AP closes on Friday for Q4 and they need the PO dated before month-end. They also split charges across AWS and Azure chargebacks (two internal SKUs). They want the commit discount to apply if combined spend across both clouds hits the tier.
jasmin_dealdesk: Oof. Marketplace attribution is per provider offer_id+sku. Cross-provider aggregation for a single commit isn't automatic.
marc_finance: Finance: we prefer a Private Offer per provider with a shared commercial doc, but that's multi-step and takes time. If timeline is critical, we can approve a one-time manual cross-provider allocation with conditions (signed ack, credit cap, audit window).
kyle_se: Tech note: even if we manually attribute, we'll need invoice detail from both marketplaces to verify usage for reconciliation. Some providers include partner metadata, others don't. 
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Multi-provider Private Offer orchestration requires partner mapping on each provider and legal review. ETA typically 3-5 business days. See ops runbook: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/cross-cloud (access required).
jasmin_dealdesk: Options: 1) Pause start until Private Offers are provisioned per cloud and link commits (clean but slower), 2) Accept customer's consolidated PO as-is and perform manual allocation/crediting across our ledgers, 3) Create a temporary single-provider Private Offer and route more traffic there (may not match customer infra). Each needs approvals.
marc_finance: If we do manual allocation: require signed buyer acknowledgement, cap credits at $30k for POC, GL codes (REV_MULTI_01, CREDIT_RETRO_MULTI), and a 45-day claim window. Accounting also wants permission to request invoice detail from the buyer for verification.
riley_sales: Customer says they can sign ack and prefers same-day acceptance. They can't change procurement flows before month-end.
legal_bot: Legal: will accept one-time manual allocation if buyer signs ack including audit permission, credit cap, and 45-day claim window. Require deal desk log and SFDC note.
kyle_se: For billing: I'll prepare mapping snippet and a reconciliation checklist to hand to accounting if we accept PO. It will request raw invoice CSVs from AWS/Azure and mapping by line description.
jasmin_dealdesk: Drafting exception language now: "Redwood will accept OceanBank PO referencing customer internal SKUs and will manually attribute charges across AWS and Azure marketplace SKUs for the period Q4 2026. If provider metering fails to map charges, Redwood will issue a one-time credit up to $30,000 within 45 days following invoice, upon receipt of a signed buyer acknowledgement and necessary invoice detail for audit." Sending to legal + finance.
marc_finance: Finance prelim OK. Please include GL codes in final memo. Accounting: do you accept 45-day window?
marketplace-bot: Note: If we later convert to Private Offers, marketplace provisioning will lock the ratecard for each created offer until amended. Consider whether the customer wants long-term cross-cloud commit or just a temporary exception.
riley_sales: I'll send buyer the ack template and request signature immediately. If legal signs off we accept PO today.
jasmin_dealdesk: Legal approved with minor edits. Deal desk authorizes one-time manual allocation pending receipt of signed ack and PO. Action items: 1) riley_sales upload signed ack + PO, 2) kyle_se post SKU mapping & reconciliation checklist, 3) marc_finance open accounting ticket with GL codes, 4) jasmin_dealdesk log exception in SFDC.
marc_finance: GL codes: REV_MULTI_01, CREDIT_RETRO_MULTI. Accounting will only process credits with the signed ack attached.
riley_sales: Uploaded signed ack and PO to SFDC. Customer confirmed POC start tomorrow. Thanks team. :rocket:
